name: M3_DPS170MI_DelPlannedDO
description: Delete planned distribution orders by planned order number. This operation removes a planned distribution order (distribution order proposal) in M3 when it is no longer needed. The order is identified by its internal planned order number and optionally by its sub-number and company. The call does not return any business data; the response only indicates whether the delete succeeded or failed.

inputParameters.name: PLPN
inputParameters.description: Internal number of the planned distribution order to delete.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company number in which the planned distribution order is deleted.

inputParameters.name: PLPS
inputParameters.description: Subnumber of the planned distribution order to delete when applicable.
